newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: High dollar keeps lid on European feeds trade.
newsitem.headline: High dollar keeps lid on European feeds trade.

text.p: A strong dollar versus European currencies kept trade on the European meals and feeds market restricted to light nearby material this afternoon.

"The high dollar and expectations of a further drop in Chicago soymeal futures kept most buyers sidelined and we saw only a few purchases of nearby soymeal and tapioca to cover immediate needs," one broker said.
Afloat U.S. high protein soymeal traded at $350 a tonne cif Rotterdam, $5 under the midday selling level. Spot Dutch high protein soymeal fetched $357.50 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
